meta.quantity: cumulative int_0^z [-Delta sigma_zz] dz, ridge minus first isostatic column
meta.cost_panel_b: signed % change relative to the value at z_c, ridge side, mid-run
meta.cost_of_zc_rows: per-step signed % change of the PLATE-WIDE force between z_c and z*(t); z* is the RIDGE-SIDE crossing and the denominator is the plate-wide value at z*
meta.zstar: depth at which the anomaly changes sign, i.e. where the cumulative is stationary
meta.dnd_omitted: Delta N_D is not shown: it has asymptoted by 76-94 km and moves 1-2 % between 100 and 175 km, so it cannot constrain z_c
